results.reader_title: Commission proposes restoring affected Hungarian institutions’ Horizon access
results.reader_what: The Commission proposes lifting restrictions affecting certain Hungarian universities’ ability to receive Horizon Europe EU funding.
results.reader_why: If adopted by the Council, the measure reopens cross-border research funding participation for previously restricted institutions.
results.reader_more: On 23 September the Commission said rule-of-law changes justified requesting Council approval to reverse a 2022 funding restriction. Its spokesperson explicitly said the restrictions remained until the Council made a decision. The Council subsequently lifted measures in October, but that later event is not backdated to this record.
